chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.startHint: Load a IIIF Manifest in the setup panel, then create your first chapter.

chapter.manifestHint: Load a manifest to start capturing chapters.
chapter.markHint: Mark Out must be greater than Mark In for audio / video.
chapter.advanceHint: Auto-play will move to the next chapter after the delay below. Leave empty to stay on manual.

export.title: Export story JSON
export.draftIdentifiers: This export uses an identifier Mango generated under mangoviewer.dev. It is valid IIIF, but it is not your domain — set an AnnotationPage ID in Story settings before publishing.

transition.title: Chapter transition time
transition.description: Set how long to wait before moving to the next chapter. Leave this blank to require manual navigation.

audio.addUrl: Add a media URL to load its waveform.

tasks.title: Chapter tools
tasks.description: Everything about this chapter, in three groups. Sections that work on the stage open from here.

position.title: Frame
position.description: The canvas region this chapter opens on, drawn on the stage.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Timed camera points for in-chapter movement.

audio-timing.title: Narration
audio-timing.description: Voiceover tracks and chapter narration timing.

transition-timing.title: Chapter transition time
transition-timing.description: Set the delay before moving to the next chapter.

media-timing.title: Media timing
media-timing.description: Start and end points for this chapter’s source audio or video.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Visibility and opacity for image layers.

availability.annotationsMedia: Annotations are available for image and PDF chapters only.
availability.positionMedia: Viewer position is available for image and PDF chapters only.
availability.chooseImage: Choose an image or PDF source to add annotations.
availability.annotationsSpatial: Annotations need a spatial image, PDF, or 3D view.
availability.captureSpatial: Capture an image, PDF, or 3D view first.
availability.motionSpatial: Motion needs a spatial camera position to capture.
availability.layers: This source does not currently expose multiple image layers.
availability.chooseLayered: Choose a layered Manifest in Source.
availability.comparisonUnavailable: Compatible sources are loaded, but comparison chapter authoring is not enabled yet.
availability.keepSources: Keep the sources loaded for a future comparison chapter.
availability.comparisonSources: Comparison needs at least two loaded sources.

media.invalidRange: End must be later than start.
media.marksHint: Use the media controls in the viewer to set Mark In and Mark Out times.
media.editorHint: The waveform editor below the viewer controls source {type} only. Story narration is edited separately.
media.dragSelection: Drag the shaded selection to move its start and end together.
media.dragEdge: Drag either edge to adjust the start or end time.
media.longMediaHint: For long media, zoom and scroll the waveform. Use “Show selection” to return to the chapter range.
media.autoSaveHint: Preview the selection whenever needed. Dragged regions and exact time edits are saved automatically.

narration.title: Narration
narration.description: Choose the narration track and drag or resize the chapter region.
narration.dragSelection: Drag or resize the chapter selection
narration.footerHint: Use the WaveSurfer editor in the story-builder footer to adjust this range.
narration.editorHint: Use the wide editor below the viewer to choose audio and set this chapter's range.

position.title: Frame
position.hint: Pan and zoom the artwork beneath the fixed story frame. For precise IIIF authoring, you can also type the canvas region here.
position.empty: No frame yet. Type a region in canvas pixels to create one.
position.aspectLocked: Story frame {aspect}. Preview and readers preserve this exact shape; width and height change together.

annotations.drawingHint: Choose Select / Pan to edit an existing annotation, or choose a shape to add one.
annotations.emptySelection: Select an annotation from the list or artwork to edit its text and appearance.

motion.title: Move through this chapter
motion.requireTwo: Choose a movement style or add two camera points to enable motion controls.
motion.requireOneMore: Add one more camera point to preview and configure this movement.
motion.durationError: Motion duration must be greater than 0 seconds.
motion.durationDwellError: Duration must leave time to move after the {seconds}s start hold.
motion.dwellError: The start hold must be shorter than the time to the next camera point.
motion.customHint: Custom keeps each point’s frame as you drew it. Preview starts at Point 1.
motion.presetHint: Points set the focus; the movement style controls zoom. Resizing a point switches to Custom. Preview starts at Point 1.
motion.dwellHint: Hold stationary on the initial view before movement starts.
motion.durationHint: Positions are spaced across this movement time. The start hold is added before it.
motion.movePointTitle: Point {number} at {seconds}s. Click to select; drag to reposition.
motion.emptyPoints: No camera points yet. Add a point to capture the current position and zoom.
motion.captureGuideHint: Drag a pin to set its position. Then zoom the artwork and save that zoom to the selected point; the pin will stay where you placed it.
motion.selectPointToUpdate: Select a pin before saving its zoom.

cameraTimeline.title: Camera timeline
cameraTimeline.info: Keyframes preserve a canvas-space view and focal point.
cameraTimeline.empty: Capture the current view to start the camera track
cameraTimeline.narrationFallback: Add narration from the chapter timing tools.

settings.title: Story settings
settings.subtitle: Set the story title and narration audio
settings.titleHint: Shown in the story viewer top bar
settings.savedLabel: Saved as the {language} value in the AnnotationPage label.
settings.identifiersHint: Stable public IDs for the story and its chapters
settings.identifiersManaged: These identifiers are managed by the publishing host.
settings.identifiersWarning: Changing this base will change the public IDs of previously published chapter Annotations.
settings.audioSourceHint: Used by every narrated chapter in this language
settings.audioPreviewHint: Enter a URL to preview the narration track.
settings.draftIdentifiers: Without an AnnotationPage ID, Mango generates one under mangoviewer.dev. Exports stay valid IIIF, but set your own domain before publishing.

overlay.previewChapterHint: Play this chapter on its own, exactly as the story presents it.
overlay.chapterPreviewPlaying: Playing this chapter. Click to stop.
overlay.sourceHint: Add the source for your story to create the first chapter. Use the viewer controls to change canvas; image placement can be adjusted afterwards.
overlay.noChapterHint: Capture a chapter or select one from the timeline to edit its content.

comparison.hint: Load at least two compatible sources to create a comparison chapter.

errors.missingPublicId: Set a canonical Story ID in Story settings before publishing.

identifiers.publishedStory: Story ID: a published story requires a canonical HTTP(S) identifier
identifiers.generatedDraft: Story ID: still a Mango-generated draft identifier — set your own AnnotationPage ID before publishing
